evidence_required: At least three assumptions and a measurement plan (tools, repetitions, statistic).

marking.criterion: Assumption 1, no overlap of the DP all-reduce with backward compute
Assumption 2, NCCL does not route around the slow link (for example PXN)
Assumption 3, illustrative 45 GB/s healthy rail and 82 % PCIe efficiency, or only DP traffic considered
L3 measurement plan with tools (all_reduce_perf across the local-rank-3 GPUs; training steps with and without the node), at least 5 runs after warm-up, median and p95

title: Why the PCIe cost estimate is an upper bound
